import.label: Media
import.title: Add your clips
import.description: Add the videos and photos you want to use, then line them up on the timeline.

cut.label: Cut
cut.title: Trim the clips
cut.description: Move the playhead to where you want to cut, split, and delete the parts you don't need.

captions.label: Captions
captions.title: Add captions
captions.description: Turn speech into captions automatically, or add your own text.

sound.label: Sound
sound.title: Add sound effects
sound.description: Move the playhead to a moment and tap an effect to drop it in.

export.label: Export
export.title: Export your short
export.description: Check the length, then export a 1080×1920 video ready for TikTok and YouTube Shorts.

import.nothingToAppend: Add a video or photo first
import.dropHint: You can also drag files into the list below, or drag a clip onto the timeline.

cut.noClips: Line up some clips in step 1 first
cut.nothingSelected: Click a clip on the timeline to select it
cut.tips: Shortcuts: S or Ctrl+K to split, Delete to remove, Space to play.
